_comment: Reference .mcp.json entries. Copy what you need into .mcp.json (project) or add with `claude mcp add`. ${VAR} expands from the environment — never paste secrets here.

ryvan-results._comment: This repo's own server (sessions/05-mcp/server.py) over stdio.

ryvan-results-http._comment: Same server over Streamable HTTP; start it with `python sessions/05-mcp/server.py --http`. Remote servers use this shape plus headers for auth.

rwa._comment: Custom REST-API wrapper (sessions/05-mcp/rest_api_server.py). Credentials via env, not args.

postgres._comment: Read-only Postgres. Use a DB role that has SELECT only; the URL comes from the environment.

sqlite._comment: Local SQLite file. Point it at a copy, not the production file.

github._comment: GitHub's official remote server. OAuth on first use; or a fine-grained PAT with only the repos/scopes needed.

slack._comment: Slack via a bot token scoped to the channels it needs (channels:history, chat:write).

playwright._comment: Browser automation (the root .mcp.json already has this). --caps vision adds screenshots.

filesystem._comment: Filesystem access restricted to listed roots — the roots ARE the security boundary.
